_comment: Not consumed by compose.yaml or deploy.sh. cloudflared's compose service runs with TUNNEL_TOKEN, which makes it a remotely-managed tunnel: a local ingress config file is silently ignored by design (confirmed against cloudflare/cloudflared issues #633/#933/#1520 -- ingress for a token-run tunnel must come from the Cloudflare API/dashboard, fetched at connect time). This file is the exact PUT body applied to the musicbox tunnel: PUT https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/120c269ad6d3dfbe6d63a0bb53758ca0/cfd_tunnel/<tunnel_id>/configurations, header 'Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN', this object as the JSON body. Interim-estate wind-down (2026-09-02): the uploader's path-scoped /upload rule and the FileBrowser inbox hostname are both retired; until the greenfield dubplate-server launches, the tunnel serves Navidrome only.
